main_text.p: concludit effatum: Natus est hic Genius Delphis, sub Apollinis Tripode: educatus autem apud Sphingem, inter Gryphos & Ænigmata: Singula ejus verba, singula mysteria, singuli verborum ambitus, singula decreta, singula sunt oracula, miro instinctu & afflatu edita, miris modis perplexa: Ipsummet audiamus: Conjugatorum sunt conjugata consequentia: Propter quod unumquodque est tale, ipsum est magis tale: Quidquid recipitur, ad modum recipientis recipitur: Nullum violentum est perpetuum: &c. Si sensum exquiras horum glossematum, aut rationem qua nitantur, in
main_text.notes: The catchword "in" sits at the lower right below the last line; the page's last line is shown as printed. Some words are set in italic in the printed text (rendered with i tags). The original long s has been written as plain s. The faint text at the far right edge is show-through from the facing page and was omitted. Unclear letters: "vio'entum" was read as violentum.
